indicators.label: Religious affiliation (%)
indicators.description: Share of the resident population of ordinary households in the four affiliation categories (Catholique, Protestant, Islam, Autre religion), computed as 100 minus Sans religion minus Non déclaré.
indicators.method: 100 minus the printed Sans religion share minus the printed Non déclaré share, rounded to one decimal (conductor ruling 2026-09-04, decision 3). No count is derived from any percentage.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Seventeen préfectures (16 préfectures and Bangui) on the geoBoundaries 2006 ADM1 boundary, which matches the 2003 census geography one-to-one by name.
indicators.quality_notes: One-decimal published shares. Non déclaré stays in the denominator and outside both numerators. Six rows sum to 99.9 or 100.1 by the source's rounding, within the 0.30 pp derived bound.

indicators.label: No religion (%)
indicators.description: Sans religion as a share of the resident population of ordinary households.
indicators.method: The published Sans religion one-decimal share from Tableau soc 6.15, carried unchanged.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Seventeen préfectures (16 préfectures and Bangui) on the geoBoundaries 2006 ADM1 boundary, which matches the 2003 census geography one-to-one by name.
indicators.quality_notes: Sans religion is a real non-affiliation category inside the denominator and outside the affiliation numerator; Non déclaré is a separate printed category.

indicators.label: Religion composition (%)
indicators.description: Per-row composition carrying the six published shares (Catholique, Protestant, Islam, Autre religion, Sans religion, Non déclaré) with labels verbatim.
indicators.method: Published Tableau soc 6.15 cells for the préfecture, carried in rows[].composition as label_verbatim and percent.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Seventeen préfectures (16 préfectures and Bangui) on the geoBoundaries 2006 ADM1 boundary, which matches the 2003 census geography one-to-one by name.
indicators.quality_notes: Percent as printed; no re-basing, no rounding, no derived count.

rows.population_total_basis: DGSEES/ICASEES RGPH 2003, Les caractéristiques socioculturelles de la population centrafricaine, Tableau soc 6.15: population résidente des ménages ordinaires de 0 an ou plus by groupe religieux and préfecture. The table prints one-decimal row percentages only; this report prints no préfecture population table, so population_total and every count are null and no count is derived from any percentage. Commune totals exist in a separate file of the same zip (Pop RCA par commune par sexe et selon le milresid.pdf) and are not carried.
